_about: The Talents (the Talents document, 16-talents.md). A card with `talent` is a Talent item (its group, theme and prerequisites as data); one with Versions is an Action too (the Talent grants it); a card whose category is a Talent's name (Pummel, Leg Sweep, Rimebrand) is the Action that Talent grants. One source per card: book/cards/README.md.

cards.name: Challenge
cards.flavor: You call them out, and they cannot look away.
cards.text: Once per round, when you deal damage to a creature with a [Melee, Strike] Action, you can challenge them: until the end of their next turn, their [Strike] Actions against creatures other than you take 1 Bane.

foundry.automationNote: apply the Challenged effect from the compendium.
foundry.append: (Apply the Challenged effect from the compendium; its Bane is a chip the attacker unticks when they attack you.)

cards.name: Heavy Blows
cards.flavor: Every swing carries the whole weight of the steel.
cards.text: When a [Melee, Strike, Weapon] Action you make with a Two-handed weapon deals damage on a Tier 3, it deals 2 more.

cards.name: Whirlwind
cards.flavor: You spin, and everything within reach feels the blade.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.flavor: The red haze settles, and you stop caring about pain.

versions.effects: For 1 round, your [Melee, Weapon] Actions are [[Empowered]] 1 and gain 2 Boons, and you take 1 Bane on Saves.
versions.ruler: always: empowered 1 turn melee weapon; boon 2 turn melee weapon

cards.name: Brawler
cards.flavor: Your hands have won more fights than any blade.
cards.text: You gain the Pummel Action. Your [[Fists]] don't have the [[Non-threatening]] property: you can flank with them.

cards.name: Pummel
cards.flavor: A flurry of blows until something gives.

cards.name: Kickboxer
cards.flavor: Your legs hit as hard as your fists.
cards.text: You gain the Leg Sweep Action: a kick, so it needs no free hand. You can use it with your hands full.

cards.name: Leg Sweep
cards.flavor: A low kick takes their legs out from under them.
cards.rules: This Action uses your [[Fists]] even when you have no free hand.

cards.name: Aim
cards.flavor: Patience turns a good shot into a sure one.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged] Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon. It ignores Low Cover.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each boon 1 | cover

foundry.automationNote: ignoring Low Cover (untick the Low cover chip in the roll dialog).

cards.name: Ricochet
cards.flavor: Walls, shields and stones are just more angles.
cards.text: Your [Ranged, Weapon] Actions can bounce off one surface on the way. The projectile goes from the surface to the creature, and you calculate Line of Effect, Cover and Sight from the center of the surface. The distance is the total the projectile travels: if you shoot at a surface 5 squares from you and the target is within 6 squares of the surface, that is an 11-square shot. You must still perceive the creature to target them. A bounced shot takes 1 Bane.

cards.name: Long Draw
cards.flavor: You pull a little further, and the arrow flies a little truer.
cards.text: With a [[Projectile]] weapon, your far range has no Bane and your maximum range has 1 Bane instead of 2.

cards.name: Steady Nerves
cards.flavor: They are in your face. You are still calm.
cards.text: Your [Ranged] Actions don't take the Banes for being Engaged.

cards.name: Battering Charge
cards.flavor: Nothing slows you down once you start running.
cards.text: When you use Charge, your Speed counts as 2 higher for its movement, and its Weapon Attack (1A) is [[Empowered]] 1.

cards.name: Cut Through
cards.flavor: You drive through the line without stopping, and strike as you pass.
cards.setup: Evade 2. During this Evade you can move through the space of any creature (you can't end in one), and you ignore Difficult Terrain.

versions.critical: Relocate (1A) the target, ignoring the Handle trait.

cards.name: Lesser Blessing
cards.flavor: A small gift from the god you follow.
cards.text: Pick one blessing from the list below, related to a god you follow. You gain its Action. (More blessings will be added.)

cards.name: Rimebrand (Cold)
cards.flavor: Frost creeps along your weapon, a gift from a winter god.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, your [Weapon] Actions deal an extra [R] 1d4 Co, and the first one that deals damage on a Tier 3 makes the target Hindered (EoT).

cards.name: Sacred Weapon
cards.flavor: You lay a hand on the steel and bless it for what comes next.

versions.effects: You touch a creature (yourself or an ally). If they are not Empowered, they become Empowered 1 for 1 round. If they are Empowered 1 (from any source), they become Empowered 2 for 1 round. If they are Empowered 2 or higher, no effect.
As 1 AP, but you can touch up to two creatures.

talent.description: You gain the Sacred Weapon Action.

cards.name: Hand of Mercy
cards._note: Pack R-classes (2026-11-04): was a Paladin Escalation Active (decision sheet item 15: utility, not the combat ladder); now a Magic Talent for any character with a [Divine] Action.
cards.flavor: A single touch undoes what the enemy worked for.

versions.effects: Choose one: the ally ends one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left; or, if the ally is Down, they can use 1 Rally Point.

foundry.automationNote: ending the effect (the Rally Point button works).

talent.description: You gain the Hand of Mercy Action.

cards.name: Class Expertise
cards.flavor: You have studied your craft longer than most.
cards.text: Choose one Encounter or Daily Action from your class's Repertoire that you don't have. You gain it.

foundry.append: (Drag it from the compendium onto your sheet.)
